semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Atkinsorb provides specialized waste gas treatment solutions that are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Atkinsorb Co., Ltd specializes in advanced solutions for the treatment of special waste and toxic gases, focusing on environmentally conscious products tailored to the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include a range of chemical adsorbents and dry scrubber systems designed to ensure effective waste management in semiconductor fabrication facilities.
capabilities: Chemical adsorbents granulates for dry scrubbers
Dry local scrubbers with patented column design
Central dry scrubber systems with customized configurations
